description: Update an existing secret value. Increments version for tracking. Use this instead of delete+store to maintain history.
embedding_description: Vault: rotate a secret. Replace the value of an existing credential, password, OAuth client_secret, API key, refresh token, or bearer token under the same vault key. Increments the version counter so audit history is preserved. Requires the vault to be unlocked. Use (not delete + store) when downstream consumers reference the secret by stable key — they keep working across the rotation.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that secret was updated with new value. Contains key (identifier), version (new version number), and message (status). NEVER contains secret values.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Updates an existing secret with a new encrypted value. Increments version counter for audit tracking.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultLocked: Vault must be unlocked before rotating secrets. KeyNotFound: No secret exists with the specified key - use store() instead. InvalidValue: New value is empty or invalid.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultLocked: Prompt user to unlock vault first. For KeyNotFound: Suggest using store() to create a new secret. For InvalidValue: Ask user to provide a valid non-empty value.
